result:
`data/` is ignored, so the test database stays out of the repo. Typecheck passes and all 6 tests pass (the `ValidationException` trace printed during `bun test` is pre-existing logging from the starter `posts.search` 422 test, not a failure).

The bug was a single off-by-one in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:16`: `index()` validated the 1-based `page` query param (defaulting to 1) and then passed `page + 1` to `paginate()`, so the ORM's already-1-based pagination started one page in — page 1 rendered posts 11–20 and the newest ten were unreachable, while the paginator's meta and links described the shifted page. I changed it to pass `page` through unchanged; ordering, per-page size, and search are untouched, and the pager's current page, first/prev/next/last links, and from–to–total now all derive from the page actually rendered. I also added `tests/PostPagination.test.ts`, which boots the real app, tops the seeded test database up past two pages, and asserts against the model's own newest-first id list that `/posts` and `/posts?page=1` both start at the newest post, that walking every page yields each post exactly once in order with correct `currentPage`/`from`/`to`/`total`/`lastPage`, and that `?page=2` marks page 2 as the active pager link — I confirmed three of those four assertions fail against the original `page + 1` code.
